title: test(cli): declare measured budgets on ten os-serve-path boot files (#23181 slice 15)

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XG3Skuzg27tRY99NwTYbbs1)_

Part of #23181 (slice 15). The card is a series and stays open.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Test-only, comment-only diff: `skip-changeset`. Ten lines under `packages/cli/test/`, which is not in `@objectstack/cli`'s `files[]` (`dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`); no `files[]` changes in any package.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:给 cli 里 10 个「真实启动 `os serve` / `os dev` / `os start`」的测试文件各加一行第 2 行的 `// test-budget:` 声明,只是注释。
- 为什么改:#26256 把每次 CLI 启动从约 8 s 降到约 2 s 之后,这 10 个文件仍超 10 s;它们的耗时就是每个独立夹具各启动一次服务,没有可共享或重复的启动,按裁决 6181973363 B 声明实测预算。
- 风险与回滚:零运行时风险,不改断言、超时与分层;回滚即删这 10 行。
- 先看:`packages/cli/test/serve-config-boot-residual.integration.test.ts`、`packages/cli/test/artifact-flag-precedence.integration.test.ts` 第 2 行(预算最大的两行)。
- 两分钟验证:`node -e` 用 `scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs` 的 `readTestBudget` 解析这 10 个文件,预期 10 行都返回 `spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture`、行号 2。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One header line at line 2 of each file below, the ruled grammar `// test-budget: N — spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture: REASON` (ruling record 6181973363, letter B; grammar `readTestBudget` in `scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs`). N = slowest CI reading x 1.25, rounded up to the next 10 s. Nothing else changes: no assertion, no timeout, no tier, no helper.

| file | spawns (counted from the code) | CI run 40392443783 (s) | CI run 40424746941 (s) | local, 3 runs (s) | budget |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `test/artifact-flag-precedence.integration.test.ts` | 10 boots: 3 `os dev`, 7 `os start` (each a supervisor plus its `serve` child) | 166.18 | 206.80 | 152.9 / 153.2 / 138.3 | 260 |

## Why

**The reading.** No shard-timings refresh has run on `main` since slice 14 (PR #26256, `9c922b55c1`); the newest refresh is run 40275747937, which is older. So the CI numbers above are the vitest module lines (they include `beforeAll`) of the only two scheduled full-battery `ci.yml` runs on `main` after it: 40392443783 (head `69aa630b9f`) and 40424746941 (head `e843b5b320`). Both trees carry `packages/cli/test/helpers/oclif-manifest.global-setup.ts`, so every spawn there already has the manifest's 2 s floor. The full re-measured offender table (cli from both runs, plus a local run of the other 64 `domain:server` packages) is in the slice report on #23181.

**Why these ten are one family.** Each file's wall is real served boots of the CLI, one per distinct fixture or flag, already sequential in `beforeAll` hooks or one per case. Read per file: no boot is repeated on the same fixture and flag, and no two cases could read one boot. So the two recipes that cut time do not apply. Hoisting boots into a shared `beforeAll` gains nothing because the cases are distinct fixtures. Sharing a fixture would merge distinct fixtures. What is left is the spawn floor. The local per-case lines show it: in `serve-package-declared-capabilities` each case is one boot of 7.3 to 12.4 s, and in `serve-no-auth-secret-refusal` each case is one boot of 1.6 to 3.6 s.

**Why not the other boot files.** `dev-boot-output-order.integration.test.ts` boots one fixture several times on purpose (one order "on every boot"). `package-restart-acceptance.integration.test.ts` and `dev-standalone-self-heal.integration.test.ts` boot one database twice because the restart is what they test. The class text "once per single-cause fixture" would be false for those three, so they are left for their own reading. `serve-runtime-state-project-key.test.ts` spawns a writer child, not the CLI.

## Tests

Comment-only diff, so behaviour and wall are the tree's. A/B of a comment line measures nothing, so the after reading is the same three runs on this head's tree.

<details><summary>Local runs of the family (N=3, one lock hold)</summary>

`cd packages/cli && pnpm exec vitest run --project integration --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=default` plus the ten files, three times in one `os-verify-lock` hold, on a shared 4-vCPU container, manifest setup on (queue tier). Each run: `Test Files 10 passed (10)`, `Tests 71 passed (71)`, exit 0. Run walls 297.2 / 285.2 / 270.8 s. Sum of file lines 526.4 / 512.8 / 484.7 s.

</details>

<details><summary>Header parse</summary>

All ten lines parse through `readTestBudget` (exit 0): each returns class `spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture` at line 2, seconds 260 / 240 / 90 / 60 / 50 / 50 / 40 / 40 / 40 / 30.

</details>

<details><summary>Typecheck and lint</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`). `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the ten files: exit 0. `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Pin: the next shard-timings refresh lists none of these ten files in its over-budget table. Each appears under the budgets they declare, and comes back only if a run reads it over its own budget.
- Slice 11 (PR #26174) headers whose files read under 10 s in both runs above, for the next refresh to drop: `test/generate-refuses-retired-generator.test.ts` (9.95 / 9.67 s) and `test/generate-refuses-name-outside-charset.test.ts` (8.77 / 6.49 s). Under 10 s in one run only: `-namespace-prefix` (13.11 / 8.61) and `-unparseable-name` (12.37 / 7.82). Still over in both: `-unimportable-alias` and the five `build-*` files. Other slices' headers under 10 s in both runs: `serve-plugin-auth-load-failure-refusal` (9.86 / 7.15) and `serve-datasource-mapping-before-sync` (7.64 / 5.08). ⛔ Not lowered by hand, per the order: a refresh re-sizes them.
- The budgets rest on two CI readings. A refresh over its 20-run window may read one of them higher, and that is the refresh's job.

## Verification

Local gates at `0863e1aa3`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 54 commands. Each one ran with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all 54 exit 0. One of them, `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, first exited 3 on the shallow clone; it exited 0 after `git fetch origin 621a487607`. `--ran` reconciliation: `54 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 54 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on the touched files: exit 0)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the maintainer brief is in Chinese, per AGENTS.md)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
